statement: Pinned xone returns errors for too-short GIP payloads, invalid chunk offsets, conflicting fragments, invalid identification sections and failed registration or initialization calls. It removes a GIP client when a status packet marks it disconnected. The inspected gamepad path has no demonstrated fixed announce or identify timeout, and the receiver pairing timeout is a separate transport feature.

applicability.revision: Standard Xbox Series where applicable; xone GIP class path also supports other compatible models
applicability.scope: bus/protocol.c:322-355, 927-946, 1111-1150, 1184-1210, 1251-1301, 1600-1714; bus/bus.c:79-109; driver/gamepad.c:483-533; dongle pairing is separately scoped.
